_about: Every coordinate, timing, line and reaction of tools/showcase.py. Scene frame metres (backup scene). Edit here, not in code.

map_upgrade._about: Applied before the run starts: b11 is stashed off-stage so it can fall later; extra rubble dressing.

emergency._about: Aftershock: the room 1 corridor collapses onto route r1. Preset landing spots; the planner already holds the detour.

sudden_fall._about: Predicted fall: b11 drops into the room 2/3 gap beside the casualty as the Responder reaches the gap. It holds, waits, then lifts it.

conversation.robot: Hello, can you hear me? I am a rescue robot. Help is on the way.
conversation.casualty: Yes! I can hear you. Please help me.
My left leg. There is a deep cut, it keeps bleeding.
A little. My chest hurts when I breathe in.

conversation.robot: Can you move your arms and legs?
conversation.casualty: My arms, yes. My left leg is stuck and it really hurts.

wounds.what: trapped, possible fracture, do not move

assessment.reply: Thank you Maria. I am leaving a bandage, a first aid kit and a blanket right beside you.
